##### Project general facts

Nobu Residences Abu Dhabi by Aldar is a branded beachfront development that brings the world-famous Nobu lifestyle to a serene island setting. Two low-rise buildings, one rising from a ground floor and a mezzanine to eight residential floors and the other to five, combine natural textures, warm colours and refined contemporary architecture. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom lofts, exclusive sky villas and penthouses.

Residents enjoy private and hotel lobbies, outdoor pools for adults and children with luxurious cabanas, a state-of-the-art gym, a spa with a sauna and a steam room, a cinema room and a tranquil Zen garden with a yoga space. Elegant private dining areas, a rooftop bar and direct access to the beach complete the offer, while owners enjoy access to gourmet venues including the renowned Nobu restaurant and hotel-style services.

Interiors emphasise natural beauty, warmth and understated elegance, with spacious layouts, premium kitchens, generous living areas and carefully selected high-quality finishes. Every residence reflects the distinctive Nobu style, creating a calm, sophisticated atmosphere for everyday living. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island is the cultural heart of Abu Dhabi, home to the Louvre Abu Dhabi, the Saadiyat Cultural District and long stretches of pristine natural beach. Upscale residences, luxury resorts, world-class schools, golf courses and beach clubs create a refined, relaxed lifestyle that blends art, education and leisure in a calm island setting close to the city centre.

Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway connects the island with Abu Dhabi city, Yas Island and Dubai. The Louvre Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Beach and Mamsha Al Saadiyat are a short drive away, Yas Island and the Abu Dhabi Corniche are close by, and Zayed International Airport is within comfortable driving distance for international travel.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious residential addresses in Abu Dhabi. Branded beachfront residences with hotel services are in limited supply, attracting high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. Cultural landmarks, top schools and a protected natural coastline underpin strong demand and long-term capital value for owners.
